verified_facts_for_writers.sac_ai_features: SAP Analytics Cloud augmented-analytics features: 'Just Ask' (natural-language query; successor to 'Search to Insight' which is being deprecated; Just Ask handles more complex syntax and returns multiple visualizations); 'Smart Insights' (auto-explains data points: anomalies, key influencers, correlations); 'Smart Predict' (automated ML for predictive models — classification/regression/time-series). 'Just Ask' introduced 2024 Q1 QRC; multi-language expansion (DE/FR/IT/ES) from 2025 Q3. SOURCE-HINTS: s-peers.com SAC AI wiki, learning.sap.com, sap.com generative-ai page. RESEARCHER: confirm current feature names/availability + Joule-in-SAC positioning before writer asserts versions/dates.
verified_facts_for_writers.joule: Joule = SAP's generative-AI copilot / conversational assistant across the SAP suite, now surfacing in SAP Analytics Cloud; SAP Business AI Q1 2026 highlights + Joule Agent Builder GA Jan 2026 (agentic analytics). RESEARCHER: verify Joule-in-SAC scope and any 'agentic' claims via SAP official before asserting.
verified_facts_for_writers.sac_excel_addin: 'SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel' connects Excel (pivot experience) to SAC models, live SAP Datasphere data, and SAP S/4HANA Cloud CDS views; requires a BI or planning license. Distinct from legacy 'SAP Analysis for Microsoft Office' (AfO, bundled with BusinessObjects/BPC). SOURCE-HINTS: help.sap.com SAC Office docs, community.sap.com. Use to teach the 'governed Excel' bridge in the BI-vs-Excel article — frame as complement, not 'rip out Excel'.
verified_facts_for_writers.market_signal_cfo: Global real-time dashboard market ~USD 12B (2023) -> projected ~USD 32B (2032), CAGR ~11.5% (per Qlik/vendor-cited figure — RESEARCHER: find primary analyst source e.g. IDC/MarketsandMarkets before citing).
verified_facts_for_writers.roi_signals: Gartner: >60% of D&A projects fail to move beyond pilot; common cause = inability to articulate/measure ROI. Typical well-run BI payback often cited <6-12 months (vendor-sourced; RESEARCHER verify/soften). ROI = ((benefit - cost)/cost) x 100.
verified_facts_for_writers.data_literacy: Gartner 2024 CDAO Survey: poor data literacy among top-5 roadblocks to D&A success; ~only one-third of enterprises provide data-literacy training. Gartner-cited: by 2026 ~80% of employees consume insights inside business apps they already use (decisions-not-dashboards shift). RESEARCHER: confirm exact Gartner stat wording/year.
verified_facts_for_writers.dashboard_design: Practitioner best-practice consensus: <=~7-12 KPIs per dashboard (cognitive overload above); F-pattern scanning -> primary KPI top-left, largest/highest-contrast; avoid 3D/pie-with-many-slices/dual-axis; pair every metric with target/benchmark + units + active date range. Sources are practitioner/vendor (DataCamp, ThoughtSpot, Domo) — frame as best-practice, attribute where a number is cited.
